name: Verify a local web workspace
description: Create and reopen a small HTML/CSS/JavaScript folder in VS Code, serve it through the approved localhost preview route, and inspect the exact URL in a modern browser.

name: Explain the browser page pipeline
description: Distinguish source files, an HTTP request and response, parsed DOM/CSSOM, rendered pixels, console output, and a saved-file refresh at beginner depth.

name: Structure semantic HTML
description: Use document metadata, landmarks, headings, paragraphs, and lists so content order and meaning remain useful without CSS.

name: Create usable links and images
description: Use correct relative paths, descriptive link text, and purposeful alternative text while avoiding private or remote-only assets.

name: Inspect and repair HTML evidence
description: Use the Elements panel, Console, keyboard traversal, and an HTML validator to connect a visible defect to source and repair one cause.

name: Predict the CSS cascade
description: Apply selectors, source order, specificity, inheritance, and explicit states without relying on !important.

name: Build a readable box system
description: Use custom properties, box sizing, padding, border, margin, typography, color, and constrained widths to create a coherent visual system.

name: Debug CSS with computed evidence
description: Inspect matched and overridden declarations, computed values, the box model, contrast, and focus styles before changing one CSS cause.

name: Arrange one-dimensional content with Flexbox
description: Choose a main axis, cross axis, wrapping, gap, alignment, and flexible growth for navigation and card rows.

name: Arrange two-dimensional content with Grid
description: Define responsive tracks, gaps, spans, and placement without fixed offsets or accidental overflow.

name: Implement mobile-first responsiveness
description: Start from a narrow layout, add content-driven breakpoints and fluid media, and verify zoom and target viewport cases without horizontal scrolling.

name: Represent browser interaction state
description: Use const and let, strings, booleans, comparisons, conditions, and focused named functions to model a small interface state.

name: Select and update the DOM
description: Use querySelector or querySelectorAll, textContent, classList, and attributes while distinguishing source HTML from the live DOM.

name: Handle browser events predictably
description: Register event listeners on native controls, read the event target deliberately, and update state before rendering a new view.

name: Model a collection with arrays and objects
description: Represent records with stable identifiers and fields, then find, map, filter, and update values without confusing an item with its displayed element.

name: Render one canonical UI state
description: Derive the displayed collection from current state, clear and rebuild the owned region safely, and use data attributes plus event delegation for generated controls.

name: Persist non-sensitive state locally
description: Serialize appropriate data with JSON, load it from localStorage through a checked fallback, and keep malformed storage from replacing known-good state.

name: Build a semantic form
description: Use labels, fieldsets, legends, suitable input types, instructions, buttons, and deliberate submit behavior.

name: Validate and report form input
description: Combine native constraints with a bounded custom rule, reject invalid input without false success, and connect clear feedback to the affected control.

name: Verify keyboard and focus accessibility
description: Check meaningful order, visible focus, native keyboard operation, error focus, status announcements, contrast, and 200 percent zoom without claiming automated perfection.

name: Fetch and parse JSON through HTTP
description: Use async and await with fetch, check response.ok, parse JSON only after a successful response, and use a project-relative localhost URL.

name: Represent request states honestly
description: Show distinct loading, success, empty, HTTP failure, malformed-data, and retry states while preserving the last valid data until replacement succeeds.

name: Debug browser and network failures
description: Reproduce one case and use Console, Network, Sources breakpoints, status, stack, and inspected values to repair one cause before rerunning it.

name: Verify an integrated static application
description: Trace requirements to normal, boundary, invalid, responsive, keyboard, storage, network, and reload checks and record expected versus actual evidence.

name: Document and publish a safe static site
description: Write reproducible local-preview instructions, inspect staged paths, commit source, deploy with GitHub Pages, and verify the live URL without exposing secrets or personal data.
